questions.question: When did the United States declare independence?
questions.explanation: The Declaration of Independence was signed on July 4, 1776, declaring the colonies free from British rule.

questions.question: What was the main cause of the American Civil War (1861-1865)?
questions.explanation: The Civil War was fought primarily over slavery, with Southern states seceding to preserve the institution and Northern states fighting to abolish it.

questions.question: What is "The American Dream"?
options: The belief that anyone can achieve success through hard work
A famous speech by Abraham Lincoln
questions.explanation: The American Dream is the national ethos that anyone, regardless of background, can achieve upward mobility and success through effort.

questions.question: Which civil rights leader delivered the famous "I Have a Dream" speech?
questions.explanation: Martin Luther King Jr. delivered this iconic speech during the 1963 March on Washington, advocating for racial equality.

questions.question: What is the American English word for the British English "flat"?
questions.explanation: Americans say "apartment" while British people say "flat" for the same type of housing unit.
